authority.scope: strict application-service contracts, one in-memory synthetic document-domain mutation, one inert query, bounded snapshot subscription, and pure projection-replica gap recovery
interpretations: Exact requestId plus exact canonical complete envelope returns the cached prior result with no second commit or event.
Reuse of a requestId with any canonical envelope difference rejects with REQUEST_ID_REUSE_MISMATCH.
Projection sequence-gap recovery is a pure replica discard-and-refetch decision; main never accepts renderer state for reconciliation.
SyntheticCommitIdentity is a bounded transcript marker, not an Undo history entry or inverse.
Every in-memory service instance requires explicit positive safe-integer replay, commit, event, and subscription-batch capacities; no product default is invented.

contract.runtimeValidation: closed independently executable schemas; strict own enumerable data/plain-record normalization; detached frozen accepted DTOs; well-formed opaque identity scalars; closed rejection reasons; projection aggregate digests recomputed from exact canonical LogTemplateAggregate fields

comparison.method: exact structural equality, stable rejection-code equality, exact revision/event/commit cardinality, canonical request equality, and SHA-256 transcript equality

capacityBoundary.result: the 257th new mutation rejects CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED with zero mutation, the first exact request remains idempotent, reuse drift rejects, and no entry is silently evicted

concurrencyRace.invocation: Promise.all with two distinct request IDs and payloads at expectedWorkingRevision 0

injectedFaults: unknown command and unsupported contract version
extra, hidden, symbol, inherited, top-level accessor, and nested accessor fields
requestId reuse with different digest, expected revision, and scope
query minimum revision ahead of authoritative state
subscription cursor ahead of authoritative event sequence and subscription-batch overflow
invalid factory and projection-replica input, including zero, negative, fractional, excessive, extra, and accessor capacities

event sequence gap, owner/document change, base/result revision mismatch, projection identity change, forged projection aggregate digest with recomputed public commit identity, before/after digest mismatch, commit-identity mismatch, malformed replica state, and unknown event

dependencyDelta.reason: The application workspace imports already admitted internal contracts and domain workspaces for strict DTO validation, canonical request identity, aggregate decoding, and SHA-256 primitives.
dependencyDelta.comparisonMethod: Exact comparison of external lock path, version, resolved URL, integrity, dev, optional, and install-script fields against artifacts/dependency-inventory.json

custody.approvalReference: GitHub #54 explicit activation after BLD-003/#47 and BLD-009/#53 closed
custody.retention: Retain with the BLD-010 source revision and invalidate on any rerun trigger.

limitations: The command and query are synthetic boundary probes, not a product editing command or projection.
SyntheticCommitIdentity is not an Undo history entry; no inverse, Undo, Redo, or product history is implemented or claimed.

The in-memory seam never evicts silently: explicit caller capacities reject new mutations atomically at exhaustion, and subscription batches that exceed their configured capacity fail explicitly; production session retention and transport replay policy remain later work.
No Electron, preload, IPC, filesystem, network, persistence, source adapter, job, UI, or vendor behavior is implemented or claimed.
The replica helper only decides apply versus discard-and-refetch; it does not reconcile renderer state or perform transport I/O.
BLD-007 enforcement remains independently fail-closed while BLD-010 has pending close status in its topology authority record.
rerunTriggers: Application-service DTO, runtime schema, rejection reason, revision primitive, or command/query/subscription kind change
Replay, concurrency, commit, event, projection, subscription, or replica-gap behavior change
LogTemplateAggregate, canonical JSON, SHA-256, Node.js, TypeScript, manifest, dependency-lock, PI-20, D04, architecture section 6, or ADR 0008 change
Any retained artifact digest or external dependency identity/source/integrity change
Introduction of product commands, Undo/history, Electron/IPC, persistence, files, network, source, job, or UI behavior
